1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not chemically disrupt the embryo's cellular structure__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material __by a method comprising exposing the shed cellular material to a combination of temperature cycling and mechanical disruption__; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after completion of steps (a) through (c)__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and the water is maintained at a temperature that does not exceed ambient conditions during the agitation step__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation, __wherein the cold temperature is below 10°C and the heat temperature is above 50°C__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __at least two times__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material to a temperature above 50°C and agitation __in the absence of enzymatic treatment__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __at least two times__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from cell wall degrading enzymes that do not substantially harm embryo viability__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME® __or other enzymatic preparations containing cellulase and hemicellulase activities__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __using a purification method that concentrates the DNA from the shed cellular material__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field to isolate DNA-bound particles__.

11. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d) __in a quiescent state that maintains embryo viability__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping __performed on DNA obtained from shed cellular material without requiring embryo destruction__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads __using the DNA obtained from the shed cellular material__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant __wherein the plant phenotype is correlated with the genotype determined in step (c)__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed __on the DNA obtained from the shed cellular material to increase DNA quantity for downstream analysis__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __determined from the DNA of the shed cellular material, prior to germination__.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __that were not destroyed during the collection and analysis steps__.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __using robotic systems or computer-controlled instrumentation__.
